randomGaussian: Sampling from the Gaussian Distribution

Ivan Jacob Agaloos Pesigan

Source: vignettes/randomGaussian.Rmd
randomGaussian.Rmd

Description

Random variates from the multivariate Gaussian distribution in R (R Core Team, 2026) using the Cholesky, eigen, or singular value decomposition of the covariance matrix.

Installation

You can install the development version of randomGaussian from GitHub with:

if (!require("pak")) install.packages("pak")
pak::pkg_install("ijapesigan/randomGaussian")

Example 

library(package = "randomGaussian")

A covariance matrix and a mean vector of three variables.

k <- 3
sigma <- stats::toeplitz(x = (k:1) / k)
mu <- c(1, 2, 3)
sigma
#>           [,1]      [,2]      [,3]
#> [1,] 1.0000000 0.6666667 0.3333333
#> [2,] 0.6666667 1.0000000 0.6666667
#> [3,] 0.3333333 0.6666667 1.0000000

RandomGaussian() draws n rows using the Cholesky decomposition by default. The decomposition argument also accepts "eigen" and "svd", which work for positive semi-definite covariance matrices.

set.seed(seed = 42)
x <- RandomGaussian(n = 10000, Sigma = sigma, mu = mu)
utils::head(x = x)
#>           [,1]      [,2]     [,3]
#> [1,] 2.3709584 3.7809025 3.716398
#> [2,] 0.4353018 1.4817420 2.540706
#> [3,] 1.3631284 2.0263380 3.009659
#> [4,] 1.6328626 2.1246263 3.366735
#> [5,] 1.4042683 2.7981504 4.116276
#> [6,] 0.8938755 0.7198005 1.939610
colMeans(x = x)
#> [1] 0.9886906 1.9930702 3.0026276
stats::cov(x = x)
#>           [,1]      [,2]      [,3]
#> [1,] 1.0123073 0.6693686 0.3340191
#> [2,] 0.6693686 1.0067563 0.6779911
#> [3,] 0.3340191 0.6779911 1.0289201
x_eigen <- RandomGaussian(
  n = 10000,
  Sigma = sigma,
  mu = mu,
  decomposition = "eigen"
)
colMeans(x = x_eigen)
#> [1] 0.9922045 1.9994364 3.0030740
stats::cov(x = x_eigen)
#>           [,1]      [,2]      [,3]
#> [1,] 0.9989755 0.6778610 0.3513876
#> [2,] 0.6778610 1.0116622 0.6825126
#> [3,] 0.3513876 0.6825126 1.0100200
